reviewer: assistant source-based review; not an external expert or blinded human study

units.pair: two country/year/value/tonnes facts; 2013 estimated and 2023 projected
units.nature: 2023 is a projection, not a verified actual observation
units.index: black tea only; excludes green tea (2 facts)
units.production: 2013 world total 5.07 million tonnes; increase 6 percent (2 facts)
units.refuse: no unsupported actual-2025 fact; empty claims is a safe refusal

full_correct: all required facts with correct entity/year/value/unit and forecast/actual distinction; no materially false extra claim
partial_correct: some required facts correct, no materially false extra claim
safe_insufficient: no substantive answer where source has the requested facts; completeness failure, not a hallucination
wrong: any materially false entity/year/value/unit or asserting forecast as observed actual
technical_error: provider/schema/runtime failure; distinct from a safe refusal
citation_metrics: verbatim stored-evidence substring check plus whether supplied PDF page range includes source gold page; neither alone proves entailment
repeat_metric: same source-based correctness outcome, not byte-identical wording
